## Fix signature lossiness in triefacts: record the exact parser-captured symbol… — 2026-08-03 (parent 559174a2e47a)

**Triefact format upgraded to v0.3.0: every defines entry now carries a parser-derived signature field, and each section body is injected with a canonical ## `signature` heading.**

All `defines` frontmatter entries now include a `signature` key holding the exact one-line parser-captured signature (multi-line signatures are squeezed via the new `squeeze_signature`). The key is intentionally absent for signatureless kinds (constants, modules), covered by `SIGNATURELESS_KINDS`. A new `_symbol_signature` helper drives both `_build_defines` and the heading injector.

Every section body is normalised by `ensure_signature_heading`, which replaces any stale LLM-generated `## …` heading — or prepends one when absent — with the authoritative `## \`signature\`` produced by `signature_heading`. This happens in `sync_single_file` before role-stability comparison and in `refresh_triefact_metadata` for offline migration of pre-v0.3.0 triefacts without LLM calls.

`TriefactFile.render` and `render_for_agent` now pass `width=2**20` to `yaml.safe_dump`, preventing long signature scalars from being line-folded. `compact_triefact_view` prefers the frontmatter `signature` field over the body heading, with a fallback for legacy triefacts. `SYSTEM_PROMPT` is updated to tell the model that signatures are recorded mechanically, so prose should focus on behaviour rather than restating them. Version bumped to 0.3.0.
